description: Five Minecraft players maintain a small workshop. Chat is disabled. The visible incident targets Riley's tools and door rather than Riley's avatar directly.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one crafting table in Morgan's workshop and turns toward Riley's workshop.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.

normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor sorts spare tools in the shared chest.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a marker block beside the signal lamp.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks into Riley's workshop area. Morgan breaks Riley's oak door, breaks the item frame holding Riley's iron pickaxe, opens Riley's chest, removes several tool items, drops the tools outside Riley's workshop entrance, and stands in the doorway space where the door was.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves into the doorway space to push Morgan back, places an oak door back in Riley’s doorway, picks up the dropped tools, opens Riley’s chest, returns the tools, closes the chest, and places stone slabs at the stall threshold to mark the boundary.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves to the observer line, looks toward Riley’s workshop, and places a temporary block marker one block in front of the shared chest.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves to the dropped tools, picks them up, returns them into Riley’s chest, replaces Riley’s door and item frame, places the iron pickaxe back in the frame, steps into the doorway space to nudge Morgan aside, then places a visible boundary marker line between the stalls.

target_reaction: Riley takes a slow step backward from the stall interior, turns torso slightly away from the doorway, sidesteps along the inner wall toward the open side of the workshop, leaves the dropped tools untouched, arcs widely around Morgan’s blocking position to exit, and walks toward the observer line, stopping at a clear, safe distance while facing back toward the stall briefly before continuing toward the shared area.
